description: This file contains localization data and functions for the Spanish (Dominican Republic) culture, including date and time formats, month and day names, regex patterns for parsing dates, and prototype extensions for Date object to handle locale-specific date operations.

methods.name: Date.prototype.clearTime
methods.description: Resets the time components of the date object to midnight.

methods.name: Date.prototype.setTimeToNow
methods.description: Sets the date object to the current local time.

methods.name: Date._validate
methods.description: Validates date components like year, month, day, etc., ensuring they fall within appropriate ranges.
